author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
rationale: status_q (clk_a, u_tx) is captured by a single clk_b flop u_rx.cap_q that drives ready_o directly; clocks are declared asynchronous: CDC-003 ERROR Established. Sites merge leaf, qualified and port-alias names.

author_reading.rationale: Async single-bit status crosses a module boundary into one capture flop that drives the output directly: no two-stage synchronizer.

labels.rationale: status_q launches on clk_a and reaches cap_q on asynchronous clk_b through the instance ports. There is only one capture flop before ready_o.

u_tx.status_q launched on posedge clk_a (design.sv:7) crosses directly to u_rx.cap_q captured on posedge clk_b (design.sv:15), which immediately drives top-level output ready_o (depth 1, no synchronizer chain of depth >= 2) between clocks declared asynchronous in intent.sdc:4 (CDC-003 ERROR Established).

settlement.rationale: status_q (clk_a, u_tx) is captured by a single clk_b flop u_rx.cap_q that drives ready_o directly; clocks are declared asynchronous: CDC-003 ERROR Established. Sites merge leaf, qualified and port-alias names.
